name: companies-by-technology
title: Companies by Technology — Technographics from Job Posts
description: Find companies using Snowflake, Salesforce, dbt, Kubernetes or 600 more technologies, read from 19,000+ companies' job posts. One row per company with its tech stack and job counts. $15 per 1,000 companies.

company_name.description: Company name as shown on its job board

company_board.description: Board token of the company's job board with the most jobs naming the requested technologies (see boards for all)

ats.description: Applicant tracking system (ATS) of that board

careers_url.description: Public job board page of the company (the board in company_board)

boards.description: Every job board of the company: {ats, token, careers_url, open_jobs, jobs_with_text}. Boards with the same company name (ignoring legal suffixes) and the same board token are one company

technologies_matched.description: The requested technologies this company's open jobs name, with the number of jobs naming each: {technology, jobs}, most jobs first. Counts only jobs that pass the location and department filters

top_technologies.description: The company's tech stack as named in all of its open job posts: up to 15 {technology, category, jobs}, most jobs first (whatever technologies you asked for)

jobs_mentioning_matched.description: Open jobs whose title or description names at least one of the requested technologies (each job counted once), after the location and department filters

open_jobs_total.description: All open jobs of the company across its boards in tonight's index (an opening listed on two boards counted once)

jobs_with_text.description: Open jobs whose full description was read when the index was built. Lower than open_jobs_total where the platform's list has no descriptions (Workday: titles only), so a technology can only be found in the job title there

sample_job_urls.description: Up to 3 public job posting URLs that name the requested technologies (open them to see the context)

source_url.description: The ATS API or feed URL the company's main board was read from

fetched_at.description: When the nightly index build read the company's boards (ISO 8601, UTC)
